title_vi: Tám khái niệm của thiết kế hướng miền: bảy có chỗ đối chiếu, một kiểm bằng mã

claims.claim_vi: Source: eight concepts - domain-driven design (drive design through domain modeling, unified language), business entities, model boundaries (loose boundaries among sets of domain models), aggregation (cluster treated as a single unit for data changes), entities vs value objects (value objects have no ID), operational modeling (objects as operators), layering the architecture (layered like a computer network), build the domain model.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft domain analysis: ubiquitous language is a shared vocabulary created by developers and domain experts within each bounded context and the same word (account) can mean different things in different contexts; a bounded context is the boundary where a specific domain model applies and contexts interact (context map); four-step process (analyze domain, define bounded contexts, define entities/aggregates/services, identify microservices); design microservices around business capabilities, not horizontal layers like data access or messaging.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft tactical DDD: entities have a persistent identity, value objects have no identity and are immutable, an aggregate is a consistency boundary with one root, domain services hold business rules spanning entities and application services orchestrate use cases.
claims.verified_by: Read from the same local clone.

claims.claim_vi: Layer check with ast: allowed imports from the same or lower layer in the list presentation, application, domain, infrastructure; a 12-file toy project with 1 injected violation: 1 found in 0.001-0.002 s; 10,000 files and 30,000 layer imports with 0 violations: 0 found in 0.71-0.78 s; with 5 injected: 5 found in 0.69-0.75 s.
claims.verified_by: Program run by the author on 2026-10-19 (three runs); generated toy projects only.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: tám khái niệm và bảy chỗ đối chiếu, hai nghĩa của chia tầng, bộ kiểm tầng.
source_deviations: The source is a picture with eight short paragraphs; the lesson keeps the eight concepts in order, adds a cross-check column, separates two meanings of layering and adds a runnable layer check.
The layer check runs only on generated toy projects.
